headline: A 2006 executive order assigned the Department of Homeland Security duties related to faith-based and community groups.
what_it_does: This order from President George W. Bush gives the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) responsibilities involving faith-based and community organizations. Similar orders for other agencies set up an office inside the agency to work with these groups and look at how they take part in its programs. No summary was provided, so the exact details of this order are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: The order addresses how these groups work with and take part in Homeland Security programs.
The department is given new duties related to working with faith-based and community groups.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 7, 2006; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
